name: Varga
title: Ore Broker
examine: Scales calibrated to the grain, eyes calibrated finer. Every barrow of deep ore crosses her counter before it sees daylight.
lines: Ore bought, ore sold, ore weighed in front of you. The dark keeps honest scales — nothing to distract them.
Bursar Odele takes my ledger up the stair every night. The bank and I have never disagreed by so much as a pebble. We're both very proud and neither of us says so.
Mithril? Adamant? Walk the galleries with your own pick. Starfall? Walk faster than the spider.
